upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact commit. Moving main cannot inherit qualification.

materialChanges: Adds private Hugging Face Dataset sources through a Git credential helper restricted to huggingface.co instead of embedding credentials in repository URLs.
Control-side validation may receive HF_TOKEN while catalog discovery remains secret-free and inference/GitHub credentials remain separate.
Adds Git LFS to control and parent images so admitted private Dataset repositories can materialize LFS objects; missing Git LFS fails before source resolution.
Private-source admission is required to fail closed before model inference when token, source access or materialization prerequisites are unavailable.
Adds moving-Jobs pagination and reconciliation hardening so mutable remote job listings do not silently become complete-history evidence.
The upstream implementation explicitly requires token non-disclosure in source, arguments, responses, browser payloads and logs.

acceptance: Use only a purpose-created non-sensitive private Dataset or a deterministic synthetic equivalent; no production/private business corpus is admitted by this wave.
Pin the Dataset repository and revision/content inventory exactly and record cryptographic digests for every fixture consumed by the evaluator.
Prove the Git credential helper answers only for huggingface.co and that credentials are not embedded in clone URLs, argv, persisted config, output, logs, receipts or benchmark artifacts.
Prove catalog discovery remains secret-free and trial agent/model environments never receive the control HF_TOKEN unless a separately admitted contract requires it.
Prove missing token, denied repository access, missing Git LFS, LFS materialization failure and revision drift all fail before inference with explicit UNAVAILABLE/HOLD evidence.
Prove read-only Dataset access; no commit, upload, delete, grant change or visibility mutation is permitted by the evaluation credential.
Exercise rollback and credential rotation/revocation, including cached checkout cleanup and deterministic denial after access removal.
Treat moving Jobs pagination/reconciliation as observation only and require bounded scans plus explicit partial-history state rather than inferring completeness.

deduplication.result: material successor observation because private Dataset retrieval introduces a new credential, data-access and LFS materialization boundary

alignment.claimBoundary: Private Dataset source support is evaluation infrastructure only. It does not authorize production corpus ingestion, token-scope broadening, training, model qualification, provider writes, serving-route changes or publication.
